prediction.unit: lying: the worst entry on its own scale (the rate's band [0.2236, 0.2256], round 2's 0.2246 unchanged since it was turn-invariant)
prediction.why: a world-frame coupling after a turn t is cos t sin t (c1 - c2) plus the body's own on cos^2 and sin^2: its own size is a cancellation, so its relative miss rose to 0.40 at some turns; in the body's frame the entries are the body's, whose worst probe B read as T_y +28.5 %, and round 2's two seeds whose turns kept the cancellation small read 0.286 and 0.287

prediction_tilted.why: probe B's +17.9 %; round 2's world-frame pin 0.1793 at seed 1

prediction_spread.unit: the largest difference between two seeds' worst entry (and worst rate), each tilt
prediction_spread.why: the plane, the near-contact form and the force points turn with the body; what is left is the hand-over's opened wall and the quadrature's rounding

gate_1_spheroids_in_the_references_frame.metric: the worst entry in the reference's frame, which a turn about the normal cannot move, so a spread over seeds is the node's own failure to turn with the body
